featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Contrary to the negative reviews here (not invalidating them at all -- just sharing my perspective), I had a great, swift, and smooth experience at this POPSK. I'm glad I didn't change the appointment location to Lower Parel on reading the reviews.

Firstly, the POPSK is located very close to Sion-based landmarks such as Sion railway station, Gurukripa restaurant, and SIES College. You can reach by cab directly or take a rickshaw, get down at Cafe Vrindavan (opposite Sion station), and walk to its left. It's barely two minutes from there. Lots of Xerox shops nearby, so no need to worry about getting last-minute copies. There's an elevator at the POPSK, besides a staircase, so it's great for those with limited mobility (the office is on the first floor).

To expedite the process, ensure you bring originals and copies of  your documents (for renewals, your old passport, Aadhaar card, and, in case you're married, your marriage certificate are enough) and upload digital copies of your Aadhaar card, etc., on the DigiLocker app. The staff I encountered was extremely patient, kind, swift, polite, well-behaved, and helpful, so if you forget anything, they'll guide you accordingly.

The process has become so simplified that I was out in 50 minutes. (I reached there nearly 1.5 hours before my appointment time, and after some shopping nearby following the procedure completion, I was taking a cab back to my parents' house at my printed appointment time!) If your appointment time allows, try to go as early in the morning as possible once the POPSK opens to avoid the post-11 a.m. crowds. Although it's said they follow the appointment system, it looked like first-come-first-served to me, as my process wasn't stalled for an applicant with an earlier appointment time.

The place is clean. There are separate washrooms for ladies and gents. The ladies' washroom, despite being almost clean, needs some maintenance. Carry paper soaps and/or sanitisers. Ample, comfortable seating available. Overall, I'm very happy with my experience at this POPSK, and I would recommend it to anyone wondering whether to book their passport appointment here.

One important point: before leaving the office, the security person insists you fill out the feedback form. It seems that the more feedback he collects, the better bonus he receives, so you cannot exit without completing it.

A useful tip: ensure you already have valid documents and keep your Digilocker with Aadhaar card ready on your mobile phone. This saves time and avoids last-minute hassles.

Overall, the process was smooth and efficient, though crowd management in B and C sections and the forced feedback requirement could be improved.
